import os
import signal
import time

counter_fd = int(os.environ["BPFREJIT_OTEL_COUNTER_FD"])
x = 1
n = 0

def report_counter(_signum, _frame):
    payload = f"counter={n} monotonic_ns={time.monotonic_ns()} sink={x}\n"
    os.write(counter_fd, payload.encode("ascii"))

signal.signal(signal.SIGUSR1, report_counter)
os.write(counter_fd, b"ready\n")
while True:
    x = ((x * 1103515245) + 12345) & 0xffffffff
    n += 1
